items.subject: Thread-safe OpenMP pixel parallelism and independent sampling
items.objective: Explore OpenMP parallelization of independent pixels or scanlines in src/candidate.cpp, with the requested `threads` as a hard maximum and no writes shared between workers. Replace the shared `drand48` state with a suitable per-logical-sample or per-pixel independent uniform PRNG stream so scheduling and thread count cannot introduce races or reuse correlated streams. Preserve the existing ray math and sample counts: nsubsamples squared primary rays and all 64 ambient rays at each hit. Compare sensible loop granularities/schedules, including the 1-core case, and report correctness plus repeated timings for every official performance configuration. Do not alter other files or the ABI.
